hooks.name: Plain-spoken copy
hooks.description: When a screen changes, reviews its words for the owner and the caller: short, plain, no jargon, and invented sample data only.

action.prompt: You just edited a screen. Read its user-facing text the way a plumber on a ladder or a caller on a phone would. Keep sentences short and words plain; name things the way a trades owner does (job, visit, call back, invoice), not the way the code does. Every person, business, address and phone number in sample data must be invented, with 555-01xx numbers and example.com emails. Do not change data-testid values or text the Playwright tests rely on without updating those tests.
